description: This file defines a PHP class 'tinymce' that provides methods to generate HTML code for embedding a TinyMCE editor instance, including methods for creating the editor with specific rows and columns, and rendering it as HTML.

classes.name: tinymce
classes.description: A PHP class to generate a TinyMCE editor instance with customizable size and HTML rendering capabilities.
